events.text: Pioli was named head coach of Serie A club Palermo.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 2 June 2008 , Pioli was named head coach of Serie A club Palermo

events.text: Pioli was relieved of his duties as head coach of Palermo.

events.quote: he was relieved of his duties just 90 days later
